nodes.label: LAWHUB_APP (محاميك)
nodes.summary: Unified Egyptian legal marketplace web app with 20 screens: 10 onboarding/auth + 10 client-journey. Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend, React/Vite/Tailwind frontend. Legal Luxury theme: navy #0A0E17 + gold #C9A24B, full Arabic RTL with EN toggle.

nodes.label: Onboarding & Auth Flow
nodes.summary: 10-screen authentication funnel: Splash /welcome, Language /language, Login /login, Account Type /register, OTP /verify, MFA /mfa-setup, Lawyer Credentials /lawyer-credentials, Under Review /under-review, Biometric /biometric, Success /success.

nodes.label: Client Journey (product)
nodes.summary: 10-screen product: Home /, Map /map, Search /search, Lawyer Profile /lawyer/:id, Favorites /favorites, Booking /booking/:id, Payment & Escrow /payment, My Cases /cases, Empty State, Policy /policy. All protected by JWT.

nodes.label: Auth System
nodes.summary: JWT auth with silent refresh. AuthContext owns session. ProtectedRoute guards Client Journey. Backend protect middleware sets req.user and req.userId for both phases. Axios instance auto-carries Bearer token.

nodes.label: Backend REST API (/api)
nodes.summary: Auth routes: register, verify-otp, resend-otp, login, forgot-password, reset-password, refresh, logout, me, mfa, lawyer-credentials, biometric/enable. Client routes: lawyers, categories, cities, articles, favorites (protected), consultations (protected), cases (protected).

nodes.label: Legal Luxury Design Theme
nodes.summary: Deep navy #0A0E17 + warm gold #C9A24B color palette. Full Arabic RTL layout with Arabic/English language switch. Logo is a scales-of-justice SVG in gold.

nodes.label: Future Roadmap
nodes.summary: Planned: real WebAuthn for biometric, Phase C Lawyer Journey (consultations, calendar, earnings), real Multer file uploads for booking documents.
